Chocolate Gooey Bars
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 18, 2009 - 11:24pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup butter
1 pkg. super moist German chocolate cake mix
1 1/2 cups miniature marshmallows
1 (6 oz.) pkg. chocolate chips
2 cups Cheerios cereal
1 (14 oz.) can sweetened condensed milk

Preparation

1 Heat oven to 350 degrees. Heat butter in 15 x 10 1/2 x 1 inch jelly roll pan, in oven, until melted. Sprinkle and pat dry cake mix over butter. Sprinkle with marshmallows, chocolate chips and cereal. Drizzle condensed milk evenly over top. Bake 20-25 minutes or until cereal is golden brown. While bars are warm, run knife around sides of pan to loosen edges. Cool 2 hours. Makes 48 bars.
